# Elysium Home Decor

> Premium, minimal, animation-forward digital showroom for artisan home decor handcrafted in India and curated for global interiors.

## Core Navigation

- [Philosophy](https://elysiumhomedecor.in/philosophy): Restraint, craftsmanship, and longevity — the three pillars of Elysium design.
- [Artisan Pieces](https://elysiumhomedecor.in/artisan-pieces): Handcrafted collection featuring travertine consoles, stoneware vessels, white oak seating, and plaster pendant lighting.
- [Materiality](https://elysiumhomedecor.in/materiality): Deep dive into raw geomorphic stones, pit-fired stoneware clay, aged oak timber, and textured lime plaster.
- [Our Story](https://elysiumhomedecor.in/our-story): Atelier origins, 4,500 sq. ft. Rajkot Display Atelier, and 3-phase craft chronology.
- [Contact](https://elysiumhomedecor.in/contact): Direct enquiry channel via WhatsApp (+91 8799587361) and formal enquiry form.
